title: Fuerza Regida Announces Second Leg of This Is Our Dream Tour: See the Dates
summary: The 10-date run will visit amphitheaters and arenas in California, Georgia, Illinois and more.
contentText:
Fuerza Regida is extending its This Is Our Dream Tour with a second leg across the U.S., the band announced Monday (Aug. 10). Promoted by Live Nation, the 10-date run will begin Oct. 3 at Credit Union 1 Amphitheatre in Tinley Park, Ill., and concludes Nov. 2 at Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colo.

Fuerza Regida Turns Petco Park Into a Corridos Time Machine: 6 Best Moments From Opening Night of Their Stadium Tour

The new dates will take the música mexicana group from San Bernardino, Calif., to amphitheaters and arenas in other markets, including Charlotte, N.C.; Atlanta; Birmingham, Ala.; Albuquerque, N.M.; Bakersfield and Fresno in California; and West Valley City, Utah.

The announcement follows the conclusion of Fuerza’s historic U.S. stadium tour, which wrapped Aug. 7 at New York’s Citi Field. The first leg included sold-out shows at Petco Park in San Diego, Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles and Daikin Park in Houston, with surprise appearances from artists including 50 Cent, Tony Yayo, Lloyd Banks, Bobby Shmurda, Fenix Flexin, J Balvin, YG, Marshmello, Chino Pacas, Clave Especial, Calle 24, Chuyín and lucha libre star Rey Mysterio.

The stadium run added to a series of milestones for Fuerza, whose 2025 album  111XPANTIA  debuted at No. 2 on the all-genre Billboard 200 , the highest chart position for a música mexicana album to date. The group has also received Grammy, American Music Award, iHeartRadio Music Award, Latin Grammy and Billboard Latin Music Award recognition in the past year. This year, the band is set to make a headlining Q&A appearance at Billboard Latin Music Week.

Fuerza Regida’s second-leg tickets will go on sale Friday (Aug. 14) at 10 a.m. local time. The artist presale begins Wednesday (Aug. 12) at 10 a.m. local time; a Verizon presale begins Tuesday (Aug. 11) at 10 a.m. local time, followed by Spotify and Citi presales at noon. VIP packages will also be available.
